bestBets.overview: MANHATTAN THUNDER comes north for the first time. Mixed his form a touch back in Victoria last statrt but did show enough to suggest ge could get away with this. MATCHSTICKS is another that joins new stable. Placed at Canberra fresh when led for a long way before tiring in last couple. STORM DREAMER was in the market first-up but disappointed. She can improve off that outing while JIGADEE comes off a strong on pace maiden win this track last start and he can measure up to these.
